steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Ahhh! How could Roulecca lose? I've never lost before, not to my daddy or sister or uncle or auntie or the four-leaf clovers!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Of course not. I want to win the reward fair and square.

steps.content: Though you're low on stamina, it wasn't hard to win against a skinny little girl. The four-leaf clovers in the mirage aren't that smart, either.
She used to always win, either because of her lucky power, or...
You watch the little girl whine and lie down amidst the four-leaf clovers, who rush to comfort her... Clearly, this family spoils her rotten.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Roulecca, you didn't use your lucky power this time?

steps.content: To your surprise, she looks at you in confusion. Did she lose her Sinner power?
No. Back in reality, you could feel the Sinner power from the black goo she vomited.
According to Dr. Gandall, sweet dreams squeeze out the bad memories... Did Roulecca view her lucky power as a curse?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I tried my best! Roulecca won't lose to you again next time!
She reluctantly puts a medal engraved with a four-leaf clover in your hand.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Sob... I'm tired... We'll continue tomorrow...
Whining and grumbling, she falls back into the arms of a man who gently picks her up.
He also has a four-leaf clover head, but his persona is clearly different from the other clover clones.

steps.speaker: Roulecca's "Father
steps.content: Hello, Chief of Minos. I'm <color=#fb9259>Roulecca's father</color>. Your arrival was unexpected, but it's just what I needed.

steps.speaker: Roulecca's "Father
steps.content: Please come with me. I can help you leave this mirage.
